_comment: PlantScope v4.7 — 8 houseplant disease classes. Stage 1 detector is single-class (leaf); the disease decision is owned by Stage 2. Pests (spider_mites/aphids/mealybug/scale_insect/whitefly) are NOT classifier outputs — they appear as 'possible_pest_causes' hints per disease (see server/diseases_data.py PEST_INFO). Order matches sorted(ImageFolder.classes), i.e. alphabetical. v4.7 changes: classifier backbone EfficientNetV2-S @ 320 → EfficientNet-B0 @ 240 (better fit for ~7-8k dataset, ~4× faster CPU inference). This file is regenerated automatically by train_notebook.ipynb cell 14 after each training run; the values below are the v4.7 defaults that match the notebook (cell 12: IMG_SIZE=240, LABEL_SMOOTHING=0.05, CUTMIX_PROB=0.4, MIXUP_PROB=0.2).

training.cutmix_safe: no mixing across not_a_plant <-> plant classes
training.mixup_safe: no mixing across not_a_plant <-> plant classes
training._note: Real values overwritten by cell 14 of train_notebook.ipynb after each run.
